home.intro: Here you will see the summary of the period, with spending by category and the buttons to add an expense or an income.

transactions.intro: Here you will find all your transactions, grouped by day, with search and filters.

budget.intro: Here you will set a monthly budget, overall or per category, and see how much is left.

stats.intro: Here you will see how income and expenses change over time.

settings.intro: Here you will manage categories, accounts, backup and preferences.
